Scene 02

X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

Jose Chung

I had never thought much about it before. I guess that's because I always felt like such an alien myself-- that to be concerned with aliens from other planets... That just seemed so... Redundant.

Dana Scully

Jose Chung

If I understand it correctly, your partner is the actual expert?

Dana Scully

Yes, and I must apologize for his refusal to speak with you, mr. Chung. But I probably wouldn't have myself if I wasn't such an admirer of your work.

Jose Chung

Oh!

Dana Scully

The lonely buddha is one of my favorite novels.

Jose Chung

Here I was thinking you were just some brainy beauty. Now I find out you also have good taste.

Dana Scully

What made you decide to write a book on an alien abduction, if you're not that interested in the subject?

Jose Chung

It was my publisher's idea. I was reluctant, until I realized I had an opportunity to create an entirely new literary genre: the nonfiction science fiction. That gimmick alone will guarantee its landing on the best-seller list. In short, to answer your question, money.

Dana Scully

Just as long as you're attempting to record the truth.

Jose Chung

How can I possibly do that?

Dana Scully

What do you mean?

Jose Chung

I spent three months in klass county. Everybody there has a different version of what truly happened. Truth is as subjective as reality. That will help explain why when people talk about their UFO experiences... They always start off with, "I know how crazy this is going to sound, but--"

Dana Scully

So you're here to get my version of the truth?

Jose Chung

Exactly. When did you first find out about the case?

Dana Scully

Well, not right away, of course. Not enough time had elapsed for it to be considered a missing persons case... Before the girl was found the following morning.

KLASS COUNTY · WASHINGTON

ROKY CRIKENSON'S HOUSE

Roky Crikenson

Into the three-dimensional phenomenon known as perception. Yet you somehow brazenly declare: "seeing is believing"? Mr. Crikenson, your scientific illiteracy makes me shudder, and I wouldn't flaunt your ignorance... By telling anyone that you saw anything last night... Other than the planet Venus. Because if you do, you're a dead man.
